text:
kai: Console alerted: jump in invoke_rejects for fncall tool="catalog_lookup" on route="split-experiment-9". Top reason shows "validation_mismatch" and a bunch of "parse_error" entries. Anyone touching that route?

meera: Can you paste one of the raw lines so we can see shape?

kai: From logs (redacted): `{"req":"req_7b","tool":"catalog_lookup","error":"validation_mismatch","expected":{"type":"object","fields":["sku","attrs"]},"actual":["sku","attrs"]}`

riley: That looks like a model variant returning an array for the object union branch. We promoted an experimental tag last night. It should not have been routed to split-experiment-9 though.

duncan: Do these invokes contribute to SLA/billing pages? I got a paging alert earlier from support.

infra-bot: Alert: customer pages generated for acct=retail-co derived from invokes.rejects spike

meera: Our billing metrics count tokens but some downstream dashboards treat invoke.reject as a hard failure. We should add richer telemetry fields and a policy tag. Proposal: emit validation_reason, validation_action (blocked|coerced), validation_policy (strict|lenient), and coercion_hint when we transform. Also add sample_rate for full payloads at 2% to avoid PII leakage.

kai: Short-term mitigation: adapter can attempt to coerce array->object when length matches expected fields, set coercion_hint="array_to_object" and mark validation_action="coerced". Roll to split-experiment-9 only.

riley: Fine as a temporary mitigation but add TTL of 3h on that shim. We must not silently hide regressions. Also log original_payload and coerced_payload to S3 for audit.

duncan: For console UX: we need a per-route breakdown by validation_reason with an example payload and a one-click link to revert the last model tag for that route. Support wants a "how to fix" card that suggests rollback, adapter-shim, or model fix.

meera: Telemetry action: I'll add validation_policy to traces and a histogram metric validation_reject_rate{route}. We'll sample full payloads at 2% redacted and tag them with validation_action. Also add a metric coercion_rate and an alert if coercion_rate > 0.25% sustained for 10m.

kai: I'll open an adapter PR for the coercion shim and a short-run deploy to the split route. Also creating a quick preflight test in the model push pipeline to run 20 canonical prompts and assert output_is_object for tool-bound models.

riley: Deploy bot starting canary: adapter-coerce-temp -> split-experiment-9 (started by kai) :truck:

infra-bot: deploy finished: adapter-coerce-temp -> split-experiment-9

meera: Console filter added: validation_action and coercion_hint. Added a "coercion=true: check raw payload" note in the sample viewer.

duncan: Billing alarms for validation rejects muted for 45 minutes while we monitor.

kai: Canary shows drop in pages. Will monitor for 2 hours and then either revert the model tag or remove shim. If coercion persists, we rollback.

riley: Follow-up: add a post-rollout gate that checks shape on a small live sample before finalizing route split. That should prevent this leak in future.
